command:
set -eu
swap_path=/swapfile
[ ! -e "$swap_path" ]
dd if=/dev/zero of="$swap_path" bs=1M count=512 conv=fsync
chmod 600 "$swap_path"
mkswap "$swap_path"
printf '%s\n' '/swapfile none swap sw,pri=100 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
swapon -p 100 "$swap_path"
sync

set -eu
swap_path=/swapfile
[ ! -e "$swap_path" ]
dd if=/dev/zero of="$swap_path" bs=1M count=512 conv=fsync
chmod 600 "$swap_path"
mkswap "$swap_path"
printf '%s\n' '/swapfile none swap sw,pri=100 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
swapon -p 100 "$swap_path"
sync
